statement: The recorded “no interactions” value is incorrect and unsafe for this case: nitroglycerin is contraindicated within 24 hours of sildenafil because the combination can cause profound hypotension.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded 'no interactions' value is incorrect and unsafe" and names the sildenafil–nitroglycerin contraindication.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
